description: Deposit into a PRIVATE balance on the chosen Gloam network. Mints a note, generates the Groth16 shield proof server-side, and broadcasts shieldBound() (approving the ERC-20 first when the asset is a token, e.g. PathUSD on Tempo). The note's secret stays inside this server; the agent gets a note handle to pay from later (gloam_execute_private_pay, gloam_list_notes). Requires GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY; without it, returns a plan.

amount.description: Amount to shield into a private balance, in the asset's units (e.g. PathUSD on Tempo, ETH on Robinhood).

asset.description: ERC-20 token address to shield; omit to use the network default (PathUSD on Tempo, native ETH on Robinhood).

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset; omit to use the network default (6 for PathUSD, 18 for ETH).

network.description: Which network to shield on. Tempo shields the PathUSD stablecoin; Robinhood shields native ETH by default.

name: gloam_execute_shield
title: Execute a private shield
